title: 第17章 剑意之威第18章 血流成河
content_zh:
忽然出现的神秘高手，让牧海雄几人的脸庞上皆是浮现异色，因为他们也不太清楚此事。
这个神秘高手，所释放出来的修为气息，足有玄武境九重！
须知，这种层次的修为境界，放眼整个周云岭，绝对是最顶尖级别的存在。
因为最近几百年以来，周云岭都没有出现过地武境的强者了，玄武境九重，就是最巅峰的级别。
牧云封和宋天明等人，都是冷笑起来，显然是清楚此人。
牧帆倒是不意外，眼前的对手，应该就是他们的最后底牌，道：“玄武境九重，你是什么人？”
黑衣中年男子手握战刀，气势磅礴，打量着牧帆，他淡淡一笑，“枉安城萧家——萧钟！”
闻言，牧海雄等人都是目光一凝。
枉安城是周云岭五城池中最大的一座，其中以萧家和谢家为首，整体实力比上清风城强上不少！
由于两城之间有些距离，彼此之间很少有什么交集，是井水不犯河水的状态。
没想到今日来了这么一个人！
牧帆也听说过萧家，不过不可能因为萧钟的出现而停手，道：“今天我是来报仇的，不想惹是生非，奉劝阁下不要多管闲事。”
“哈哈哈……”
萧钟一阵大笑，“小辈，你还真是什么大话都敢说，也不怕闪了舌头，我要做什么事，你们只有服从，没有反抗的资格，你倒是好，居然威胁起我来了！”
“这么说，你是执意要做这出头鸟了？”
牧帆神色一寒。
今日谁阻他，便杀谁！
萧钟道：“我郑重宣布一下，从今天开始，牧族和宋族，都将是我萧家的附属势力，不对，是整个清风城，明白么？”
有萧钟在，宋天明底气十足，喝道：“牧帆，今天有萧大人在此，你还敢在此口出狂言，还不快快束手就擒，兴许萧大人会放你一命！”
宋天明这么说，是故意激怒牧帆，因为他要后者死，牧帆死了，他才能安心。

“今日谁阻挡我报仇，我便杀谁，你萧钟也不例外。”
牧帆说罢，体内气海中，无数的灵气涌出来，流动在身体内，给全身带来强横的力量增幅，身影骤然爆射出去，惊鸿挥出。
“小小年纪就有玄武境六重的修为，确实是厉害，不过想要和我斗，还远远不够！”
说话之际，萧钟玄武境九重的气息威压完全释放，手中的战刀也是被催动，直接一刀劈出。
看到如此出色的牧帆，萧钟内心的杀意早已经起来，对于牧帆，萧钟当然也是听说过，没想到一年多过去，牧帆早已脱离废人之身，成长到这种地步。
萧钟很庆幸今日来了清风城，可以提前斩杀还在成长中的牧帆，否则牧帆崛起，迟早会威胁到他们。
武道天才出现，不能为友，就需要尽快铲除，这是很多强者都有的共识，否则早晚会威胁到他们，因为这个世界弱肉强食！
这也是为什么，强大的势力总能一直强大，弱小的势力却很难翻身。
弱小的势力中若是有什么出色的小辈出现，总会出现夭折。
而强大的势力，就算有出色的小辈出现，谁又敢轻易去招惹？
这同样也是为什么，很多出色的年轻人出现，都会立即选择加入强大势力的原因！
没有靠山，寸步难行。
二人速度快得可怕，形成的气势扑面而来。
哪怕修为低上三重，牧帆在速度上也没有落入明显的下风。
“锵！”
content_en:
The sudden appearance of the mysterious master made Mu Haixiong and others have strange expressions on their faces, because they didn't know much about it.
The cultivation aura released by this mysterious master is as high as the ninth level of Xuanwu Realm!
It should be noted that this level of cultivation realm is definitely the top level existence in the entire Zhou Yunling.
Because in the past few hundred years, there has not been a strong person in the Earth Martial Realm in Zhou Yunling. The ninth level of the Xuanwu Realm is the highest level.
Mu Yunfeng, Song Tianming and others all sneered, obviously knowing this person.
Mu Fan was not surprised. The opponent in front of them should be their last trump card. He said: "Ninth level of Xuanwu Realm, who are you?"
The middle-aged man in black held a sword in his hand and looked majestic. He looked at Mu Fan and smiled faintly, "It's in vain for the Xiao family of Ancheng - Xiao Zhong!"
Hearing this, Mu Haixiong and others all stared at each other.
Wu'an City is the largest of the five cities in Zhou Yunling. Led by the Xiao family and the Xie family, its overall strength is much stronger than that of Shangqingfeng City!
Due to the distance between the two cities, there is little intersection between them.
I didn’t expect such a person to come today!
Mu Fan had also heard about the Xiao family, but it was impossible for him to stop because of Xiao Zhong's appearance. He said, "I'm here for revenge today. I don't want to cause trouble. I advise you not to meddle in other people's business."
"Hahaha..."
Xiao Zhong burst into laughter, "Junior, you really dare to say anything big, and you are not afraid of flashing your tongue. You can only obey what I want to do, and you have no right to resist. You are good, you actually threatened me!"
"So, you are determined to be the first person?"
Mu Fan's expression turned cold.
Whoever stops him today will be killed!
Xiao Zhongdao: "I solemnly declare that from today on, the Mu Clan and the Song Clan will be affiliated forces of my Xiao family, no, the entire Qingfeng City, do you understand?"
With Xiao Zhong here, Song Tianming felt confident and shouted: "Mu Fan, Mr. Xiao is here today, and you still dare to speak arrogant words here. If you don't hurry up and arrest him, maybe Mr. Xiao will spare your life!"
Song Tianming said this deliberately to anger Mu Fan, because he wanted the latter to die. Only after Mu Fan died could he feel at ease.
"I will kill anyone who blocks my revenge today, and you, Xiao Zhong, are no exception."
After Mu Fan said that, countless spiritual energy surged out of the sea of energy in his body and flowed through his body, bringing a tyrannical increase in strength to his whole body. The figure suddenly shot out and swung out in a shocking wave.
"You have reached the sixth level of Xuanwu Realm at such a young age. It is indeed powerful, but it is not enough to fight me!"
As he spoke, the pressure of Xiao Zhong's ninth-level Xuanwu Realm aura was completely released, and the sword in his hand was also activated, and he slashed out with one blow.
Seeing such an outstanding Mu Fan, the murderous intention in Xiao Zhong's heart had already aroused. Of course, Xiao Zhong had heard about Mu Fan. He did not expect that more than a year later, Mu Fan had already escaped from the body of a disabled person and grown to this point.
Xiao Zhong was very glad that he came to Qingfeng City today and could kill the still-growing Mu Fan in advance. Otherwise, Mu Fan's rise would threaten them sooner or later.
Martial arts geniuses appear and cannot be friends, so they need to be eradicated as soon as possible. This is the consensus of many strong people, otherwise they will be threatened sooner or later, because in this world, the jungle eats the strong!
This is why strong forces always remain strong, but weak forces find it difficult to stand up.
If there is any outstanding junior among the weak forces, they will always die young.
As for powerful forces, even if outstanding juniors appear, who would dare to provoke them easily?
This is also the reason why many outstanding young people will immediately choose to join powerful forces when they appear!
Without a backer, it is difficult to move forward.
The speed of the two was terrifyingly fast, and the momentum they formed rushed towards them.
Even if his cultivation level was lower than the third level, Mu Fan was not at a significant disadvantage in terms of speed.
"Qiang!"
